HOME SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

   A. Only carbon dioxide
